name: blit_multiplane_image_pair
description: Computes plane offsets and blit dimensions from two source records, then programs the blitter with control, mask and modulo values for a series of multi-plane copies. The second set of copies runs only when the second record has non-zero size fields, and DMA is enabled before the blits.

name: run_blits_from_pointer_table
description: Sets fixed blitter control and mask values, then issues five blits whose source pointers come from a data structure. The routine brackets the sequence with calls through a library vector.

name: unlink_entry_from_list
description: Walks a singly linked list from its head and, when it finds the given entry, replaces the link pointing at that entry with the entry's own next pointer, which is stored at offset 28.

name: report_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists for this 27-instruction routine. Its listed facts show no hardware registers, no referenced text and no calls, so its purpose cannot be determined from the evidence.

name: chain_three_subroutine_calls
description: Calls two helper routines without arguments, then calls a third helper with its 16-bit parameter. It accesses no data directly and only sequences its callees.

name: clear_entry_state_fields
description: Passes the structure to a helper routine, passes its 16-bit field at offset 2 to a second helper, then zeroes a 32-bit field at offset 20 and a byte at offset 11.

name: process_list_until_empty
description: Repeatedly takes the first entry of a linked list and passes it to a helper routine until the list head is empty.

name: report_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists for this 153-instruction routine. It calls three routines and touches no hardware registers or text, and the listed facts do not show what it does.

name: blit_rect_with_error_check
description: Converts four stored rectangle coordinates into a bitplane offset, width and height. It passes a referenced error text to a helper when the area exceeds a limit, then programs the blitter with a control value selected by the parameter.

name: blit_overlapping_list_rectangles
description: Walks a linked list of rectangles and, for each one overlapping the current bounds, calls helper routines and adjusts its edges using a lookup table. It programs the blitter's source, destination and modulo registers for the updates.

name: blit_four_plane_block
description: Reads a record's width, height and data pointer, then blits the block to four bitplanes spaced by the plane size. The second argument is written to the blitter as a word value.

name: blit_block_to_upper_planes
description: Reads a record's size and data pointer, then blits the block at offsets of two, three and four times the plane size. It also writes a stored constant and a control word to the blitter.

name: register_rectangle_slot_entry
description: Fills a 32-byte table entry with coordinates, computes its right and bottom edges from size bytes in a second table, sets its active flag and stores a pointer to it. It then calls a helper routine.

name: layout_text_list_box
description: Measures the longest string in a null-terminated string list, positions a box so it fits the display width, then draws the box and its strings through helper routines.

name: draw_rows_and_reset_entries
description: Draws stacked rows from the bottom upward, stepping eight units at a time and drawing each row's entries through helpers. It then clears a set of 32-byte entry slots.

name: build_text_entry_slots
description: Walks a null-terminated list of strings and creates a slot for each, placing slots in rows 16 units apart from a start of 48. It sets each slot's flags and calls helpers to initialise it.

name: return_entry_value_and_reset
description: Returns a 16-bit value from the list entry chosen by two stored indices when that entry is flagged, and resets the first index to none. It calls two helper routines.

name: dispatch_entry_to_library
description: Stores a table entry pointer and a flag byte chosen by the parameter, then passes the stored item, the flag and a length from a second table to a library vector.

name: update_entry_hover_selection
description: Checks coordinates against the list entry rows. When they move onto a different row, it deselects the old row and selects the new one through helpers, and it clears the selection when the coordinates leave the rows.

name: copy_padded_label_and_draw
description: Copies a list entry's string into a 20-byte buffer, pads it with spaces to a width derived from a stored count, and passes it with a style chosen by the entry's flag to a library vector at computed coordinates.

name: advance_selected_slot_pointer
description: When a stored selection is set, toggles a 0/1 slot index and loads the table pointer for that slot before calling a helper. When an option flag is set it also reads a value through a library vector and passes it on, then loads the next table pointer.

name: draw_clamped_cell_outline
description: Looks up a cell's bounds in a grid table, clamps them to a 20-column by 200-row drawing area, and draws the cell outline through library vector calls. When a flag is set, it first prepares five copies of the cell's data at fixed offsets.

name: blit_rectangle_in_strips
description: Splits a rectangle into horizontal strips sized from its width and a fixed budget of 812 bytes, and calls two helpers for each strip until the whole area is covered. The strip bounds are clamped to the rectangle's bottom edge.

name: shuffle_fifteen_table_entries
description: Shuffles the first fifteen 16-bit entries of a table using random values from a library vector, then resets fields of the given structure and calls a helper.

name: and_mask_table_rows
description: ANDs 16-word entries from a rotating table into a destination buffer row by row, calling a helper at each row end. After all rows are done it clears a flag byte and stores a value in the structure.

name: stub_empty_return
description: A three-instruction routine that returns at once without doing any work. It is reached only through a pointer in data.

name: wait_for_matching_item
description: Repeatedly calls library vectors to fetch an item, checks its 16-bit field at offset 24 against the value 104, and releases each item until the match is found.

name: poll_items_until_match
description: Loops calling library vectors to fetch and release items, setting a flag when an item's 16-bit field at offset 24 equals 104, and stops once the flag is set.

name: open_graphics_and_intuition_libs
description: Opens the graphics and intuition libraries through a library vector and stores each base pointer. If an open fails, it passes the matching error text to a helper, and a failed intuition open also closes the graphics library.

name: open_screen_and_window
description: Calls a library vector to open a screen, then one to open a window on it, storing both pointers. If either open fails, it passes the matching error text to a helper.

name: call_library_with_length_32
description: Passes a stored pointer, the parameter and a length of 32 to a library vector.

name: call_library_fixed_buffer_32
description: Passes a stored pointer, a fixed buffer address inside the global data and a length of 32 to a library vector.

name: pass_pointers_to_library
description: Passes two stored pointers, one after the other, to a library vector.

name: release_two_library_pointers
description: Passes the two library base pointers stored by the startup routine to one library vector, once each.

name: write_decimal_digit_or_zero
description: Writes the character zero when the value is zero. Otherwise it calls a helper and a library vector to produce a digit and writes that digit character to the buffer, returning the position after it.

name: append_digit_to_buffer_field
description: Converts a value with a helper and a library vector, writes the resulting digit character at the buffer pointer stored in a structure, advances that pointer and returns it.

name: build_cell_index_tables
description: Scans a 64-entry flag table and, for each non-empty entry, records its index in a reverse lookup table and assigns it the next sequential number. It calls a helper for each entry it records.

name: compute_rounded_grid_position
description: Computes an x and y position from the difference between two coordinate pairs, dividing by a step with rounding to the nearest half step, and stores both results.

name: compute_rounded_grid_position_offset
description: Computes an x and y position from a base pair, an offset pair and a step size, rounding each division to the nearest half step, and stores both results.

name: compute_rounded_grid_row
description: Computes one row coordinate from a base value, an offset and a step using the same rounded division as its neighbours, and stores it.

name: record_slot_flags_and_count
description: Stores a 3-bit value from a table lookup into a global index and, for values other than eight, marks a flag entry. It then advances a 5-bit counter and calls two helpers.

name: append_counter_to_chain
description: Advances a 5-bit counter and stores it at the end of a chain of entries, where each entry's link byte points to the next, or in the head when the chain is empty. It also stores a 3-bit value from a table lookup.

name: mark_and_append_chain_entry
description: Marks a flag entry for values other than eight, advances a 5-bit counter and appends it to the chain whose head the caller selects. It calls two helpers.

name: append_record_to_chain_tail
description: Walks a chain to its last entry, links a new record there using the current counter, and fills the record's fields from the caller's bytes and fixed marker values.

name: fill_record_and_check_type
description: Stores the current counter in a slot, writes four fields and two marker values into its record, and when the type is three and a field differs from the caller's, calls a helper.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Calls one helper routine and returns. It does no other work.

name: create_record_with_counter
description: Advances a 5-bit counter, writes a record with two bytes from each of its two parameters, and stores the counter as the current index. For type five it also stores a 3-bit value from a table lookup.

name: lookup_table_value_and_return
description: Stores a 3-bit value from a table lookup into a global, then returns a separate byte from the global data.

name: mark_flag_and_return_byte
description: Marks a flag entry when its first argument is not eight, then returns a stored byte.

name: allocate_and_fill_record
description: Looks up a record from a table, marks it active, obtains a new entry through a helper, and fills the entry's fields from table values, including a pointer computed from another table.

name: append_entry_to_list
description: Appends an entry to the end of a singly linked list whose head pointer is in global data, clears the entry's link, and returns the previous head.

name: append_to_list_tail
description: Walks to the end of a list from the given node, links the new entry there and clears the new entry's link field.

name: link_entry_after_node
description: Sets the given node's link field at offset 16 to the new entry, then clears that entry's own link field.

name: unlink_entry_from_chain
description: Finds the link that points to the given entry in a chain, using a link at offset 16, replaces it with the entry's own next link, then calls a helper.

name: dispatch_entries_by_type
description: Walks a linked list and passes each entry to a helper chosen by its type byte, combining the helper results. It returns one when the list is empty.

name: count_terminated_entry_list
description: Counts entries in a word list selected by an index and ended by the value 65535, stores the count in the record, and calls helpers.

name: count_list_into_record
description: Copies a list pointer selected by an index into a local, counts entries until the value 65535 terminator, and stores the count in the record. It then calls helpers.

name: count_entries_and_set_flag
description: Counts entries in a list until the value 65535 terminator, stores the count and a flag in the record, and selects a list pointer by index.

name: set_record_index_and_flag
description: Sets a record's type byte to eight and its flag to one, computes a table index from a list entry or a parameter, and stores a word looked up through that index.

name: load_record_table_words
description: Advances a list pointer, loads two 16-bit values from tables using a byte from the record, and passes one of them to a helper.

name: conditionally_advance_entry_pointer
description: When a counter byte in the entry is below a limit byte, loads a pointer from the entry's parent, passes values through two helpers and stores the result back into the entry. Otherwise it leaves the entry unchanged.

name: step_entry_pointer_and_update
description: Loads a pointer from a node, passes it through helpers, then updates the node's counter byte and stored pointer, with a branch on a global flag. It calls five helpers in total.

name: store_result_and_set_flag
description: Sets a 16-bit field of a structure to one, copies a stack-frame value into the pointer argument, and returns zero.

name: build_credit_text_block
description: Builds a text block that begins with the referenced label 'Quartex 1988:' and passes it through six helper calls, using a 36-byte stack buffer for the formatted content.

name: decrement_field_and_scan_entries
description: Decrements a 16-bit field by eight, calls a helper to test an entry, and when that succeeds walks a linked list of entries to find the one to process.

name: load_entry_fields_from_table
description: Loads a pointer from a table when the stored pointer is empty, copies two fields from the record into the structure, and calls two helpers. It returns a boolean result.

name: count_word_list_into_byte
description: Counts entries in a word list ended by the value minus one, halves the count when a flag byte is zero, stores it in a record byte, clears the flag and loads a table pointer.

name: store_halved_count_and_entry
description: Stores half of a count in a record byte, clears a flag byte, loads a table pointer and a list entry, and calls helpers. It returns a boolean result.

name: advance_record_counter_and_call
description: Loads a pointer from a record, passes a value through helpers, increments a counter byte in the record, and calls helpers with the record's fields. It returns a boolean result.

name: store_value_return_zero
description: Stores a value from the stack frame into the pointer argument and returns zero.

name: reset_entry_when_flag_clear
description: When the entry's flag byte is zero, clears the flag. It then either passes a table-derived value and the entry's field to a helper, or zeroes a 16-bit field.

name: clear_flag_load_table_entry
description: Clears a flag byte in the structure, loads a table pointer when none is stored, computes a table entry from the first 16-bit value and calls two helpers. It returns a boolean result.

name: set_entry_state_and_call
description: Stores a field from the second structure, calls two helpers with it, sets a 16-bit counter to one in the structure and returns a boolean from a further test.

name: store_stack_value_return_zero
description: Copies one stack-frame value through a pointer argument and returns zero.

name: emit_encoded_pairs_until_terminator
description: Walks a byte stream of two-byte pairs, passing each pair with its high bit set to a helper with coordinates from the second byte minus 64, until the terminator value 255 is reached and the flag is cleared.

name: emit_encoded_pairs_from_record
description: Walks a byte stream of two-byte pairs held in a record, passing each pair with its high bit set to a helper with coordinates from the second byte minus 64, until the terminator value 255 clears the record's flag.

name: read_next_byte_from_stream
description: Reads the next byte from a byte stream held in the structure and advances the pointer. When the next byte is the terminator value 255, it clears the flag instead, and it returns one.

name: read_next_stream_byte
description: Reads the next byte from the stream in the structure, stores it and advances the stream pointer, returning one.

name: clear_stream_flag
description: Clears a byte field of the structure and returns one.

name: draw_entry_pair_when_flagged
description: When an entry has a non-zero count and its flag byte is one, passes the entry's two coordinates to a helper, then calls helpers with a second coordinate pair derived from the first. The derivation is chosen by the low three bits of the first coordinate.

name: map_coordinates_to_cell_index
description: Converts a coordinate pair into a 6-bit table index using masks, shifts and an inversion, then passes the pair and index to helpers. Its layout closely follows its neighbours in the same group.

name: test_cell_flag_bit
description: Converts a coordinate pair into a table index with the same bit manipulation as its neighbours, then passes the flag bit 64 from that cell and the index to a helper.

name: select_code_from_conditions
description: Chooses a small numeric code from conditions on its two parameters, using the low three bits of one of them, and passes that code with the second parameter to a helper.

name: clear_long_block_and_init
description: Zeroes a block of 512 longwords, then calls a library vector to fill a stack buffer with the value ten. It stores the first returned longword in global data and sets bits of a flag word from the global data.

name: store_or_halve_table_value
description: Calls helpers, and when the zero flag is set returns half of a helper's value. Otherwise it stores the value and an extra word into a table slot chosen by a counter and returns the value.

name: adjust_global_offset_when_equal
description: When the low bit of a value is set and two stored values are equal, adds their difference to a global offset and calls a library vector. Otherwise it returns the values unchanged.

name: read_eight_bits_msb_first
description: Reads eight bits one at a time through a helper, whose zero flag decides each bit, and shifts them into a 16-bit accumulator, most significant bit first.

name: build_code_lookup_table
description: Iterates over 256 word pairs, each giving a code length and a code value, and fills a lookup table with the codes. Lengths up to eight are handled directly.

name: decode_coded_byte_stream
description: Reads codes from a byte stream through a bit reader and a lookup table, writing decoded values through the pointer arguments. Helpers handle the bit fetches and the table access.

name: stub_no_operation
description: A six-instruction routine that performs no operations and returns.

name: read_word_or_advance_counter
description: When its count argument is non-zero, it returns a word read through a pointer argument. Otherwise it advances a global counter by a fixed amount, calls a library vector and returns the next word read from a stored pointer.

name: decode_counted_stream_block
description: Decrements a stored count, then reads bytes through a bit reader and helper calls until the count is exhausted, writing results through the pointer arguments.

name: read_word_from_stream_pointer
description: Clears a 16-bit counter, calls a library vector, and reads a byte from the stored stream pointer, advancing it. It reads a 16-bit word instead when the pointer's alignment requires it.

name: advance_stream_position_by_delta
description: Computes the distance between two stored pointer values plus 512, subtracts a parameter, adds the result to a global and calls a library vector.

name: init_buffer_and_clear_flag
description: Calls a library vector with a buffer and a fixed mask of 67108864, runs three helpers and clears a 16-bit flag.

name: dispatch_by_state_value
description: Calls a library vector, then calls one of three helpers depending on whether a stored 16-bit state is zero, one, or another value, and returns the helper's result.

name: set_flags_and_call_helpers
description: Sets two 16-bit flags to one, calls several helpers and a library vector, and makes two extra helper calls only when a stored value is zero.

name: shift_record_table_down
description: Shifts up to 104 records of 8 bytes each by one slot, and resets the stored record count to minus one.

name: shift_record_table_up
description: Decrements the stored record count, shifts the 8-byte records from the first slot onward so each is copied into the previous slot, and writes the first record.

name: reset_state_variables_from_flag
description: Resets three 16-bit state values, setting one to 200 or zero depending on a flag byte. It also clears two longword values and a flag byte, then calls two helpers.

name: run_eight_call_passes
description: Runs a loop eight times, calling four helpers on each pass, then calls one more helper. Finally it sets two 16-bit values to zero and one.

name: reset_counter_and_copy_longs
description: Sets a 16-bit counter to minus one and copies two longword values from one pair of globals to another.

name: store_two_bytes_in_slot
description: Writes the two bytes of its first 16-bit argument into a four-byte table slot chosen by the second argument.

name: load_slot_byte_and_call
description: Clears two 16-bit fields and calls a helper. When that succeeds, it reads a byte from a 32-byte slot chosen by a counter, stores it in global data, sets a 16-bit flag and calls helpers.

name: dispatch_state_switch_cases
description: Clears a 16-bit field and switches on the low byte of a stored state value. Each case calls helpers and resets the state, and the default case resets it to zero.

name: run_state_handler_and_reset
description: Calls a helper, calls a library vector, resets a stored 16-bit state to zero and calls a helper again.

name: loop_state_dispatch_while_flagged
description: Repeatedly dispatches on a 16-bit state value through three helper calls, clearing a flag on each pass, while a second stored value equals two.

name: reset_fields_and_run_branch
description: Calls four helpers, clears two 16-bit fields, then branches on a stored value and calls helpers in each branch.

name: select_resignation_text_and_run
description: Copies several stored values, then calls ten helpers. It appears to choose between the referenced texts 'Blue resigns' and 'Red resigns' according to a stored state.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without any work.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without any work.

name: select_table_index_from_nibble
description: Reads a byte from a library vector, finds the first table position whose value exceeds its low four bits, calls a helper that many times, then stores the next value masked to six bits.

name: scan_stored_entries_until_empty
description: Sets a flag and calls helpers. When a stored counter is below a limit, it walks 8-byte entries until one has a zero first byte, copying values between table slots.

name: advance_counter_with_scan_loop
description: Increments a 16-bit counter and compares it with a stored value. When the counter reaches that value, it resets a second counter and loops through helper calls until its condition ends.

name: read_balanced_bit_pairs
description: Reads a value, and when it is below 128 loops over byte pairs, adjusting a balance counter by whether each byte has bit 64 set or exceeds 127. The loop ends when the balance reaches zero, and a final value is stored.

name: skip_until_bit_64_set
description: Repeatedly calls a helper until the value it returns has bit 64 set, then returns.

name: skip_balanced_bit_pairs
description: Repeatedly reads byte pairs, adjusting a balance counter by the top bit of one value and bit 64 of another, until the balance reaches zero.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without any work.

name: store_library_result_twice
description: Calls a library vector with a zero argument and stores its result into two global longwords.

name: store_library_delta_from_base
description: Calls a library vector with a zero argument, stores the result, and stores its difference from a previously saved global value.

name: add_counter_to_indexed_total
description: Calls a helper, then adds a stored longword to the entry of a 32-bit table selected by the parameter.

name: forward_two_arguments
description: Passes its two arguments unchanged to another routine and returns.

name: append_position_record
description: Writes a pair of stored longwords into the record slot after the current count, copies them into two other globals, and calls a helper with the same values.

name: shift_history_and_count_step
description: Increments two stored counters and calls a helper, then shifts a three-word history of stored 16-bit values by one position.

name: rotate_three_words_and_decrement
description: Rotates three stored 16-bit values by one position, calls a helper, then decrements a stored counter.

name: call_helper_around_indexed_byte
description: Calls a helper, reads a byte from a 32-byte slot chosen by a counter, calls the helper again and returns the helper's result.

name: dispatch_state_low_byte
description: Masks a stored state value and, when its high nibble is zero, switches on its low byte. The cases call a helper, reset the state or set a flag.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without any work.

name: invoke_stored_handler
description: Calls a handler through a function pointer stored in global data, then returns.

name: update_mode_from_state
description: Sets a stored mode from the high byte of a state value. Mode zero sets a timer value of six, and mode ten calls library vectors and stores the result.

name: handle_mode_ten_library_result
description: When the stored mode is ten, calls library vectors and stores the result. A zero result restores a mode from the caller's frame, while any other result is stored as a timer.

name: restore_mode_from_frame
description: Copies a 16-bit value from the caller's frame into the stored mode field.

name: set_timer_from_mode_shift
description: Sets a stored timer to five shifted left by the mode minus one, and clears two counters.

name: copy_timer_with_minimum
description: Sets one flag to one and another to zero, copies the stored timer into a second value and raises that value to a minimum of three.

name: copy_byte_block
description: Copies a block of bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer, with the number of bytes given by the count argument.

name: compare_byte_strings_counted
description: Compares two byte sequences up to a given length. It returns zero when they match, otherwise the difference of the first mismatching bytes.

name: clear_text_list_entries
description: Walks a table of linked text lists, writing a space over the first character of each entry and clearing its byte at offset six. It then sets a flag and performs further setup.

name: start_loop_with_library_setup
description: Calls a library vector with a fixed argument of 524288, increments a stored counter and copies two stored values into a pair of globals. It then runs a loop of helper calls until a flag ends it.

name: loop_until_position_matches
description: Clears a byte flag and increments a counter, then repeatedly calls helpers until two stored 16-bit values equal the stored target pair, and returns a byte result.

name: wait_until_pair_matches
description: While a flag byte is set, calls a helper until two stored 16-bit values match a stored target pair, then copies the matched pair into two longwords.

name: pack_board_state_bytes
description: Packs pairs of stored 3-bit values from a grid into bytes, writing a leading byte from a stored value and continuing across the grid cells.

name: initialise_board_cell_loop
description: Sets two stored values from its byte argument, flipping one with a bit, then calls helpers for each cell in an 8-by-8 loop.

name: check_red_piece_count
description: Counts pieces on the board through a helper for each cell, and returns the referenced text 'Red has too many pieces.' when the count is too high.

name: check_blue_piece_count
description: Compares piece counts against a limit and returns the referenced text 'Blue has too many pieces.' when the limit is exceeded, otherwise an empty result.

name: check_red_king_count
description: Checks the red king count and returns the referenced text 'Red has too many Kings.' when it is too high, otherwise an empty result.

name: check_blue_king_count
description: Checks the blue king count and returns the referenced text 'Blue has too many Kings.' when it is too high, otherwise an empty result.

name: check_red_king_present
description: Returns the referenced text 'Red needs a King.' when no red king is counted, otherwise an empty result.

name: check_blue_king_present
description: Returns the referenced text 'Blue needs a King.' when no blue king is counted, otherwise an empty result.

name: check_kings_adjacent
description: Compares the two king positions against a table of neighbour offsets and returns the referenced text 'Kings are adjacent.' when they touch, otherwise an empty result.

name: check_blue_in_check
description: Tests the blue king's position against eight direction offsets and returns the referenced text 'Blue is in Check.' when one matches. Otherwise it calls helpers and returns their result.

name: return_red_check_text
description: Returns a pointer to global data that holds the referenced text 'Red is in Check.'

name: return_zero_result
description: Returns zero.

name: reset_counter_after_calls
description: Calls two helpers, then clears a 16-bit counter.

name: return_smaller_word_half
description: Returns the smaller of the two 16-bit halves of its argument.

name: return_larger_word_half
description: Returns the larger of the two 16-bit halves of its argument.

name: return_absolute_low_word
description: Returns the low 16-bit half of its argument, negated when it is zero or below.

name: scan_entries_for_match_flag
description: Adjusts a stored counter around two helper calls, then loops over stored entries while a flag byte is set, returning zero when the flag is clear.

name: handle_end_of_game_status
description: Checks a king status with a helper. A zero result calls a library vector with a fixed value, while any other result swaps stored side values and runs helpers. The referenced texts 'Check and mate...Game over.' and 'Stalemate. How boring!!' belong to this outcome.

name: copy_board_snapshot_and_update
description: Copies stored position values into two backup slots, reads a board byte to update a board entry, then calls a helper.

name: load_piece_bits_from_table
description: Reads a byte pair from a table at an index given by the parameter, stores the first byte in a global, calls a helper, then stores two 2-bit fields taken from the second byte.

name: pack_state_flags_into_record
description: Writes a byte from a state global, and a second byte combining several shifted state values, into a two-byte record at an index taken from the parameter.

name: check_flag_values_gate_result
description: Copies two stored longwords into a scratch area, then returns zero when a stored value is zero or a flag equals one or six. Otherwise it returns a value computed through a helper.

name: conditionally_call_and_report_state
description: When a stored state entry equals two, calls a library vector with a stored record and a helper. It then passes a stored byte and word to a helper.

name: read_byte_at_offset
description: Calls a library vector with a base pointer plus the parameter's low word, reads one byte through a second vector and returns it.

name: return_compare_equal_result
description: Calls a comparison helper on its two arguments and returns true when the result is zero.

name: call_library_with_zero
description: Calls a library vector with a stored table pointer and a zero value.

name: initialise_grid_and_counts
description: Sets 120 words of a stored table to 16, then clears a grid of bytes laid out with 32 bytes per row.

name: collect_cells_per_level
description: Loops over stored values from one to six, matching each against a 4-byte table. For each match it updates a position record, and a helper runs when the value reaches six.

name: report_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists for this 24-instruction routine. The listed facts show only its two callers and its instruction count, so its purpose cannot be determined from the evidence.

name: swap_two_indexed_longwords
description: Swaps two longword entries of a table, indexed by the two 16-bit halves of its argument, then updates a related index value.

name: clear_entry_and_grid_cell
description: Clears a byte entry of a table selected by the argument's low half, then clears a byte in a grid with 32 bytes per row at the position stored for that entry.

name: store_entry_and_grid_cell
description: Writes the high byte of its first argument into a table entry chosen by the second argument, then writes the low byte into a grid cell addressed with a 32-byte row stride.

name: store_entry_byte_check_count
description: Stores a byte into a table entry and into a grid cell at the entry's stored position. It then compares a stored count with a limit and calls a helper when the count is below it.

name: branch_and_call_helpers
description: Branches on whether its third argument is zero and calls helpers with a byte argument or a stored word. Then, when its second argument is non-zero, it calls more helpers.

name: fill_position_table_from_offsets
description: Clears a block of table words through a library vector, then loops over stored offset pairs to compute and write positions. Indices below four use one set of values and the rest use another.

name: compute_table_flag_result
description: When its first argument is six, calls a helper and returns a flag that is set when the result equals one. Otherwise it searches a table of stored entries and returns the result found there.

name: check_position_offset_match
description: Adjusts the second argument's position by a stored offset, then returns one when the entry at that position has the value six and matches the first argument's byte. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: scan_stored_positions_downward
description: Calls a helper, then when it returns zero scans a stored list of table positions downward, testing each entry against the given position.

name: report_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists for this 36-instruction routine. The listed facts show only one call, its two callers and its instruction count, so its purpose cannot be determined from the evidence.

name: match_entry_bytes_to_word
description: Compares a table entry's first byte with the second argument and its second byte with a stored word. When both match, it computes a table index for the result.

name: check_entry_active_state
description: Returns true when the word at offset four is zero, the byte at offset seven is zero, and the byte at offset six is neither zero nor six.

name: count_entries_until_helper_fails
description: Counts stored 8-byte entries, stepping backward from the current count, until a helper returns zero, and returns that count.

name: evaluate_neighbour_positions
description: Loops over positions around a stored index and calls two helpers for each one, returning a 16-bit result.

name: read_word_before_pointer
description: Returns the 16-bit value stored two bytes before the base pointer in global data.

name: dispatch_value_by_low_bits
description: Tests bit patterns of its second argument and branches to one of several sequences. Each sequence calls helpers with values derived from the argument, and the routine returns a 32-bit result.

name: record_entry_if_below_limit
description: When a counter is below 80, stores the current pair of longwords from globals into the next 8-byte slot of a table and increments the counter.

name: run_helper_for_each_value
description: Sets a flag to one, calls a helper for each byte value from two to five, and clears the flag at the end.

name: evaluate_entry_against_neighbours
description: Clears a flag, copies a byte from a table selected by a counter, and computes a difference against a stored position. It then calls three helpers and returns a value.

name: compute_entry_bit_result
description: Clears a flag, copies a byte from a table selected by an index, clears a second byte, then computes a result from bytes of a table entry and returns it.

name: scan_and_collect_flagged_entries
description: Resets two counters, then loops over table entries and calls five helpers for each entry whose stored byte is set.

name: pop_next_stored_entry
description: When a read counter is below a write counter, copies the next 8-byte stored entry into two globals and advances the read counter.

name: return_low_bit_of_word
description: Returns the lowest bit of the low 16-bit half of its argument.

name: process_table_data_routine
description: A 960-instruction routine that calls five helpers. Its pseudo-code declares very large local arrays that look like decompiler artefacts, so its exact behaviour is not reliably recovered from the evidence.

name: count_set_bits_via_helper
description: Shifts a 16-bit argument right one bit at a time, calls a helper at each step, and counts the steps where the helper returns a non-zero value.

name: compute_weighted_three_value_index
description: Reads three values through a helper, combines them with weights of 40, 20 and 8, and returns the negated sum as a 32-bit result.

name: compute_table_offset_with_base
description: Computes a table index from two parameters with multipliers of 240, 2 and 1440, then returns that index added to a value from a second table.

name: copy_inverted_table_word
description: Stores the bitwise complement of a table word in a global, copies a word from one table into the next record slot, and calls a helper.

name: copy_complement_table_words
description: Copies a table word into a global, reads a second table word and stores its complement in a list entry, then calls a helper.

name: compute_weighted_result_by_mode
description: Starts from a value of six, zeroes a stored word, and branches on the parameters to choose a computation. It calls five helpers and returns a 16-bit result.

name: initialise_state_and_run_helpers
description: Copies a byte from one stored area into another, sets a flag to one, calls ten helpers and clears two stored fields.
